title: Imagine Swimming

services.name: Lap swim
services.desc: Whether you're training for an event, staying active, or working on stroke efficiency, you’ll have the pool at your command in a calm, open setting. Just pick your preferred location and timing, and swim on your schedule. Monthly memberships are offered at our Crown Heights, Upper West Side, TriBeCa, and Montauk pools. (TriBeCa location is limited to Independence Plaza Residents only.) Monday - Friday: 6:30AM - 9:00AM (last entry by 8:45 AM), 6:45PM - 8:15PM (last entry by 8:00 PM) Extended weekday times: Tuesday/Thursday 9:00AM-10:00AM. These will not be available during school breaks, when we hold Intensive Swim

services.name: Adult Lessons
services.desc: Our signature classes for kids keep things safe, fun, and productive, with a 1:4 (group), 1:2 (semi-private), or 1:1 (private) student-to-teacher ratio. It’s the perfect balance of skill-building and social connection. At Imagine, we aim for 30, 40 & 60 minutes of active swim time-because little swimmers learn best when they’re engaged, challenged, and having fun in the water. With small class sizes and responsive, child-centered teaching, we keep students moving with activities that build confidence, coordination, and comfort at every level. Every minute in the pool truly counts. Offered at our TriBeCa, Upper West Side & Crown Heights Armory locations 7 days a week from 9am - 6pm. TriBeCa

explain.meaning: A small lesson shared by two or three people.

addons.name: Weekly group lessons (4 swimmers per instructor)

blurb: Since 2002, Imagine has welcomed thousands of families to our pools. Our mission? To foster a lifetime of safe fun in the water. Learning to swim is an essential piece of every child’s education. It’s never too early, or too late, to start.
